Somali text / title: Maxamed Ibraahin Warsame Hadraawi (1943–2022)

Somali text / title: Yaa ahaa Hadraawi? — Noloshiisii iyo socdaalkiisii
Suugaantii Hadraawi — Erayo, maansooyin iyo riwaayado
Hadraawi iyo nabadda — Erayadu dadka way isu keenaan
Dhaxalka Hadraawi — Adiguna sheekada sii wad
Maxamed Ibraahin Warsame, oo loo yaqaanay Hadraawi, wuxuu ahaa abwaan Soomaaliyeed oo aad loo qadariyo.
English / supporting detail: Maxamed Ibraahin Warsame, known as Hadraawi, was a much-respected Somali poet.

Somali text / title: Wuxuu ku dhashay gobolka Togdheer sannadkii 1943.
English / supporting detail: He was born in the Togdheer region in 1943.

Somali text / title: Wuxuu ahaa gabayaa, qoraa iyo hal-abuur suugaaneed. Wuxuu qoray gabayo, heeso iyo riwaayado.
English / supporting detail: He was a poet, writer and creative artist. He wrote poems, songs and plays.

Somali text / title: Suugaantiisu waxay ka hadashay xorriyadda, caddaaladda, jacaylka bulshada iyo nabadda.
English / supporting detail: His writing explored freedom, justice, care for the community and peace.

Somali text / title: Wuxuu dhiirrigeliyey suugaanta Soomaaliyeed iyo isu soo dhawaynta bulshada.
English / supporting detail: He encouraged Somali literature and helped bring communities together.

Somali text / title: Sannadkii 2012, waxaa la guddoonsiiyey Abaalmarinta Prince Claus.
English / supporting detail: In 2012, he received a Prince Claus Award.

Somali text / title: Wuxuu ku geeriyooday magaalada Hargeysa 18-kii Agoosto 2022.
English / supporting detail: He died in Hargeisa on 18 August 2022.

Somali text / title: Hadraawi wuxuu ka tegay dhaxal suugaaneed qiimo weyn u leh ummadda Soomaaliyeed.
English / supporting detail: Hadraawi left a valuable literary legacy for Somali people.

Somali text / title: Suugaanta Soomaalidu waxay isticmaashaa erayo qurux badan, laxan, sawir-maskaxeed, celcelis iyo xarfo isku dhawaaq ah. Hadraawi wuxuu hal-abuurkiisa ku soo bandhigi jiray fikrado iyo dareen.
English / supporting detail: Somali literature uses beautiful language, rhythm, imagery, repetition and alliteration. Hadraawi used his creative work to share ideas and feelings.

Somali text / title: Gabay iyo maanso waa tix; tiraabtu waa hadal ama qoraal aan tix ahayn. Hees waa erayo la luuqeeyo, riwaayadna waa sheeko la matalo. Maahmaah, miisaan iyo hal-ku-dheg waa erayo kale oo suugaanta lagu barto.
English / supporting detail: Gabay and maanso are forms of verse; prose is not verse. A song is sung, while a play is performed. Proverbs, metre and mottos are other literary ideas.

Somali text / title: Hadraawi wuxuu rumaysnaa in suugaanta iyo erayadu dadka isu soo dhawayn karaan. Wuxuu ku boorriyey bulshada nabad, caddaalad iyo isfaham. Sannadkii 2004, wuxuu ka qayb qaatay socdaal nabadeed.
English / supporting detail: Hadraawi advocated peace, justice and reconciliation. In 2004 he took part in a peace march.

Somali text / title: Markaan si ixtiraam leh u wada hadalno, waxaan maqli karnaa fikradaha dadka kale oo aan dhisi karnaa wadajir.
English / supporting detail: Respectful words can help people understand one another.

Somali text / title: Hadraawi wuxuu raad weyn ku reebay gabayga iyo suugaanta Soomaaliyeed. Dadku waxay ku xusuustaan hal-abuurkiisa iyo dadaalkiisii nabadda.
English / supporting detail: Hadraawi left a lasting contribution to Somali poetry and literature, and is remembered for his creative work and peace efforts.

Somali text / title: Markaan akhrinno, qorno oo aan tix tirinno, waxaan ilaalinaynaa afkeenna. Carruurta maanta ayaa noqon kara abwaannada iyo qorayaasha berri.
English / supporting detail: By reading, writing and reciting, young people can help keep their language alive and become tomorrow’s writers and poets.

Somali text / title: 1943: Wuxuu ku dhashay Togdheer. Hadraawi wuxuu ku dhashay gobolka Togdheer.
